review.name: Thunderbloom Kirin
findings: All twelve original source head/body slices and all 216 actual equipped-technique frames inspected. Jaw and curled cheek mane stretch in recoil, attack and death. Walk and gallop splay the upper legs; strike folds torso toward the floor and leaves feet below the preview platform in recovery. Four-view original hoof overlay independently verified: 61/61/69/69 vertices. Original 481-pose visible sole sweep finds front attack drift up to 1.43773 and floor delta down to -0.29048; actual sole head/neck contribution is zero. Original side shoulder/knee/hoof pixels picked before repair. Original battle baseline captured but not inspected. Repair and repeat review pending.

Original twelve head/body slices, all 216 actual techniques and original four-view sole overlay inspected. Jaw/cheek mane stretch, gait leg splay and a folding strike body require complete face binding, four fitted limb chains and coordinated actions. V1 numeric passes missed lower-neck stretch and four V1 head slices were rejected visually. V2 adds neck base [0,-.12,.50] and skull pivot [0,.33,.67] fitted from original anatomy, retargeting original neck/head curves at .55/.65. All twelve V2 raw head/body slices and all 216 V2 actual technique frames inspected and pass. Sculpt, original 21 bone frames/inverses, texture and 172 unaffected curves conserved; 14 fitted joints appended. Frozen face passes 1904 clip poses plus 468 blends, full geometry 1591 poses has zero warnings. Final rebuilt battle and repeat review pending

Final separate second pass actually inspected all 24 raw source/battle head/body slices, all 32 low/medium production transition slices, 24 advancing companion idle frames, all 216 actual equipped-technique frames in twelve lossless native strips and sixteen atlas cells. All pass. Frozen face 1904 clip poses plus 468 blends and full-geometry 1591 poses per asset pass. Twelve anatomical regression tests plus three animation-bank tests and production build pass. Original and final hoof surfaces are tested at 481 times per action, including between keys. Whole-roster and live release pending.

companionTechniqueAudit.label: independent-mythic-013-anatomical-v2-final-techniques
companionTechniqueAudit.finding: All nine actual techniques inspected front and side at twelve times on rebuilt battle asset. Complete jaw and mane hold shape, four legs remain connected to the torso, and no strike sinks below the platform. Attack intentionally lifts the left front hoof with three supporting feet; cast and recoil keep four supporting feet.

review.faceCameraCoverage: One kirin head with a tall horn and curled purple mane. Brow, muzzle, true side lower jaw, side cheek, horn and head mane inspected. Initial frontal lower-face point landed on neck and was rejected before animation probing; replaced with actual visible side chin. Four hooves, body ornaments and mane/body joins require full motion review.

candidateHistory.label: anatomical-v1
candidateHistory.reason: Frozen face and full geometry passed, but four inspected head slices showed lower-neck and mane stretching in death. Add independently fitted neck and head pivots and retarget original neck/head curves.
